title: Tarragona
text: Daniel P. Was our driver, got us there and back safely in a very clean and comfortable van.  Played great music, would point out things of interest along the way.  Once we got to Tarragona we met up with Chrstina our guide for our time in Tarragona.  She was enthusiastic in sharing the history of the area and made our day very enjoyable.  Loved Tarragona!  Thank you Christina and Daniel!
author: Janette_S

title: Great tour & tour guide
text: Wonderful day trip with Mehdi. Entertaining and knowledgeable tour guide. Mehdi was responsive to our special requests and sensitive to our needs as a family with a 19yo and 10yo. Lots of walking but plenty of rest as well!
author: C_O

title: Amazing experience in Tarragona!
text:
A wonderful family day, perfectly organized from Barcelona. The drive was comfortable and the guide was really engaging, we learned a lot about Tarragona’s Roman history while visiting impressive sites like the amphitheater and the Roman circus.

The free time afterwards was perfect to explore the old town at our own pace, stroll through the streets, or relax at a terrace. A great way to discover the region, mixing culture and relaxation. Highly recommended!

Big thanks to the Wine Stories team for their kindness and professionalism — you made the experience even more enjoyable!
author: 79salom_d
